title: Verify stage-8 Type A QUERY retiming and bound direct helper carriers
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Hoist the 14 paid Type A idle calls at clocks 1448–1487 before stage-8 J at port 0. Cancelling 28 ordinary ADDs makes this retiming exact. After retiming, the required stage-8 correction for demoting QUERYs 1580 and 1659 depends only on body B8 and the central phase. Its unbound inputs require two independent aggregates and its unbound outputs require one shared scatter.

The four productive helper MOVEs with the pure central rank-one quotient each fail the complete chart-0 first-contact readout. With the native suffix fixed, injection at these moves changes a helper-return minor of determinant `-5/8`. Two carriers that touch the second plane vanish at all main returns. The retiming leaves the paid and productive profiles fixed. The physical QUERY replacement remains open, with zero verified κ change.

## Task and overlap

Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Changed scope of `p104-side-correction` on exact #7113 `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d` and #7334 `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace`. One Type A port, the stage-8 host, and four named direct helper paths.

#7342–#7344 supply the standalone correction, relative rank floor and fixed-host capacity limits. This change gives the required stage-8 boundary after an exact retiming and tests the literal helper paths. #7399 studies fixed-clock idle projection. #7401 at `9b08bf7fbcd3ab1e4aa098132e4cad1bb5a91543` keeps all J calls fixed for diagonal phase retirement. The branch carries the existing #7257 CI prerequisites, followed by one research commit.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-stage8-query-carrier/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-stage8-query-carrier
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-stage8-query-carrier --check-modes --check-source-history
```

Passed on CPython 3.12.3, including the exported Git-free replay in about 1.1 seconds. The checker verifies 144 formal columns, compares the real phase result with #7343's modular oracle, rejects an uncancelled ADD, and reconstructs the carrier witnesses in both directions. The four embedded files also matched their exact source blobs. New physical lowering, ownership/adjoint and full supplier checks remain open.

## Credit

Rohan Arun's #7113 supplies the signed caller and Clear1nsight's #7334 the native comparator. ToikY's #7342–#7344 supply the formal engines and capacity checks. Dillon's #5388 gives the separate already-paid query hoisting precedent. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. ChatGPT Pro helped formulate the causal and dirty-return tests.

## Open next questions

Name a physical layout for the two aggregate reads and the extra scatter. Check cancellation of arbitrary dirty inputs before the first reads and price the complete return contract against the two deleted rank-one children at one port.
